transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I'm here because for the last six months, my mood has been completely all over the place and I have this overflowing energy that makes it impossible to sit still. I've also been getting extremely irritable over the smallest things, and I can't seem to focus on any single task. It's just getting really hard to manage.
Have these feelings of high energy and shifting moods come and go in distinct periods or waves, or is this something you've struggled with constantly since you were a child?

No, this definitely isn't something I've struggled with since childhood. It actually started pretty recently, and I've been dealing with this constant high energy and shifting moods for about the past six months.
During these times of high energy, do you find you feel fully rested after only a few hours of sleep, or do you feel exhausted but unable to sleep because of constant worry?
To be honest, I'm not really sure about my sleep patterns during those times. I haven't paid close attention to how much sleep I'm getting or how rested I feel when my energy is high.
When you have this high energy, does it ever get so intense that it causes major problems in your life, like getting you into trouble at work, or leading to risky behaviors you normally wouldn't do?

Yes, my energy is so high that I constantly start several new projects at once because I feel like I have to keep moving. However, my focus keeps shifting so quickly that I can't finish any of them, which has made managing my daily responsibilities at work and home really difficult.

Yes, I actually had a period of about three months where I felt incredibly down, empty, and completely lost all my motivation and interest in my usual activities. During that time, I just wanted to isolate myself from everyone and stay away from people.
During these high-energy periods, have you ever needed to be hospitalized, or have you experienced things like hearing voices or having unusually strong beliefs that others found unrealistic?

I haven't been hospitalized, but during those high-energy times, I have heard voices and had strong beliefs that others found unrealistic, like feeling monitored or having special powers. These experiences happened
Did these experiences of hearing voices and having these strong beliefs only happen during your high-energy periods, or did they also occur when your mood felt normal?

No, they didn't only happen when my energy was high. There was a period of about two weeks where my mood felt completely normal and stable, but I was still hearing those voices and holding onto those strong beliefs.
During those two weeks when you heard voices and had those beliefs, were you completely free of both the high-energy feelings and the deep sadness?
Yes, I was completely free of both the high energy and the deep sadness during those two weeks. Aside from hearing the voices and having those beliefs, my mood felt pretty flat and normal.

latest_inference.note: Previously, the candidates were Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type) and Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features. The patient has now confirmed that they experienced psychotic symptoms (hearing voices and holding unrealistic beliefs) for a period of two weeks when their mood was completely normal and stable, free of both high-energy (manic) and depressive symptoms. This meets Criterion B for Schizoaffective Disorder (delusions or hallucinations for 2 or more weeks in the absence of a major mood episode) and rules out Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features, where psychosis only occurs during mood episodes. Since the patient has a history of both high-energy/irritable periods and depressive episodes, Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type) is the single remaining diagnosis.
